preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 40.
The number of ingredients N must be between 1 and 10,000.
The maximum amount of each ingredient K must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= K for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be between 1 and K.
The output must consist of N repetitions of the maximum value K.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 40","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 40."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= N <= 10**4","description":"The number of ingredients N must be between 1 and 10,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= K <= 10**9","description":"The maximum amount of each ingredient K must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"len(stdout.split()) == N","description":"The output must contain exactly N space-separated integers."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"all(1 <= int(x) <= K for x in stdout.split())","description":"Each output integer must be between 1 and K."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"stdout == ' '.join(map(str, [K] * N))","description":"The output must consist of N repetitions of the maximum value K."}],"invariants":[]}
